title: Best Workout Apps to Pair with Your NZ Gym Membership
meta_desc: Find the best workout apps to pair with your NZ gym membership, including free and paid options like Les Mills On Demand
intro: With many NZ gyms offering memberships from $15-$30 per week, such as Jetts and Anytime Fitness, supplementing your workout routine with a fitness app can be a great way to stay motivated and track your progress. Les Mills On Demand, for example, offers a free 14-day trial and then costs $14.95 per month. Many Kiwis are already using apps like this to enhance their gym experience, with some popular options including Nike Training Club and JEFIT

sections.heading: Free Workout Apps
sections.body: If you're looking for a free workout app to pair with your NZ gym membership, there are several options available. Nike Training Club, for example, offers a range of workouts that can be done at home or in the gym, and is completely free to download and use. Another popular option is JEFIT, which has a huge database of exercises and allows you to create and customize your own workout routines.

sections.heading: Paid Workout Apps
list: Les Mills On Demand: $14.95 per month

sections.heading: Price Comparison of Popular Workout Apps
NZ Gym Memberships and Workout Apps
sections.body: Many NZ gyms, such as Jetts and Anytime Fitness, offer memberships that can be paired with workout apps like Les Mills On Demand. For example, a monthly membership to Jetts costs around $15-$20 per week, while a membership to Anytime Fitness can cost around $25-$30 per week. By combining one of these memberships with a workout app, you can get a great overall fitness experience for a relatively low cost.

sections.heading: Get the Best Value from Your NZ Gym Membership

cta.text: Compare NZ gym memberships and find the best value for your money

sections.heading: Les Mills On Demand and NZ Gyms
sections.body: Les Mills On Demand is a popular workout app that offers a range of group fitness classes and workouts. Many NZ gyms, such as Les Mills NZ and CityFitness, offer memberships that include access to Les Mills On Demand. For example, a membership to Les Mills NZ can cost around $30-$40 per week, and includes access to Les Mills On Demand as well as classes and equipment at Les Mills gyms around NZ.
